tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Anti-HIV activity (EC50) of labyrinthopeptin A1 (LabyA1) against laboratory-adapted and drug-resistant HIV strains determined in various cell types.
footnotes: Viral replication measured by MTS/PES method. Mean ± SEM out of 2–6 independent experiments is shown.
Viral replication measured by p24 HIV-1 or p27 HIV-2 Ag ELISA. Mean ± SEM out of 2–8 independent PBMC donor experiments is shown.

HIV-1 strains resistant to the anti-carbohydrate mAb 2G12, CXCR4 antagonist AMD3100, gp41 fusion inhibitor enfuvirtide (T20), RTI azidothymidine (AZT), INI raltegravir (RAL) and the CD4/gp120 binding inhibitor feglymycin (FGM).

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Broad-spectrum anti-HIV-1 (EC50) activity of LabyA1 against various HIV-1 clinical isolates representing different subtypes evaluated in PBMCs.
footnotes: EC50s measured by p24 Ag ELISA. Mean ± SEM out of 2–5 independent PBMC donor experiments is shown.
EC50 measured by p27 Ag ELISA. Mean ± SEM out of 4 independent PBMC donor experiments is shown.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Anti-HSV type-1 and HSV type-2 activity (EC50) of LabyA1.
footnotes: EC50, 50% effective concentration or compound concentration required to reduce virus-induced cytopathicity (CPE) by 50%. Mean EC50± SEM up to 3 independent experiments are shown. Cidofovir and acyclovir are used as reference compound.
TK−: thymidine kinase-deficient HSV strains (resistant to acyclovir, see [32] for more detail).

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Anti-HSV type 1 and HSV type 2 activity (EC50) of LabyA2, nisin and acyclovir.
footnotes: EC50, 50% effective concentration or compound concentration required to reduce virus-induced cytopathicity (CPE) by 50%. Mean EC50± SEM up to 3 independent experiments are shown. Acyclovir is used as reference compound.
TK−: thymidine kinase-deficient HSV strains (resistant to acyclovir, see [32] for more detail).
For more detail about the viral strains, see Table 3.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: Kinetic data for the interaction of LabyA1 and nisin with immobilized X4 and R5 HIV-1 gp120 envelope proteins.
footnotes: KD: affinity constant; Kon: association rate constant; Koff: dissociation rate constant.
Mean ± SD of 2 independent experiments are shown.
